text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Air Groove! It's Air Groove! 
She reigns supreme right here as the 
Junior-class queen!!
(WAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —A splendid result.
choice_data_list: You really walk the talk, huh.
You really walk the talk, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I managed to fulfill one of my 
responsibilities. However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This victory is still nothing more than a 
passing point until I can truly embody my 
ideals."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you too shouldn't let it go to 
your head. Consider the next battle to 
have already begun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Impressive as always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion when you must be 
tired right after the race. I just felt 
compelled to speak with you directly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You were watching after all... ...I'm 
humbled by your kind words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, I should be thanking you. 
That was a magnificent run. It truly moved 
me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So it was just as you believed, and my 
worries were unfounded after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize for causing you concern. 
However, please rest assured.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
On the road ahead, I shall show you a 
performance that surpasses even today's.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I look forward to your continued 
success.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to celebrate the Empress's 
glorious first step. Good work today—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Hmph. That's the last of the celebrating.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Once the new year begins, the Classic Year 
will be right upon us... Battles even 
tougher than today await.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Once we get back, our first order of 
business is a debrief on today. Make sure 
you keep up with me.

Air Groove is already looking toward the 
future. Seeing that, a fire was ignited in 
my heart to do the same!

—Ever since then, the public's attention 
on Air Groove had only grown more intense.

Which path she'll pursue in the Classic 
Year has been a daily topic of debate in 
the media.

I'll need to talk to Air Groove again. For 
now, I decide to head over to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmhââ

While on my way to the dorms, I ran into 
Air Groove in front of the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Saved me some trouble, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I actually have something to discuss with 
you. I was just thinking about contacting 
you.
choice_data_list: I wanted to talk to Air Groove too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh. Very well. Let us take this 
elsewhere."

When I confided in Air Groove that I 
wanted to consult her about upcoming 
races—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the Tiara route. —Our goal is 
the 'Triple Tiara.'

Air Groove declared without a shred of 
hesitation. Her tone was even firmer and 
more powerful than usual.

The Tiara route. It refers to running in 
three races: the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and 
the Shuka Sho.

Both are prestigious GⅠ races, and winning 
either would carve one's name into 
history, but—

"The Triple Tiara" is the supreme honor 
bestowed only upon those who conquer all 
three of those races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The legendary Umamusume of the past who 
ran the Tiara route all combined grace and 
nobility within their strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What I must demonstrate is the same—not 
merely strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A figure who captivates all who watch, 
someone whom every Umamusume yearns to 
become and chases after—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That is the ideal I must demonstrate. A 
figure befitting the title of 'Empress.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, taking on the "Triple Tiara" is 
essential in manifesting that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Above all... the Oaks is my origin.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To establish myself as the "Empress," I 
must produce results in the Oaks.

...The starting point for Air Groove. That 
would be the existence of her mother, who 
conquered the Oaks in the past.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If she announces she's taking the Tiara 
route, fans will naturally anticipate a 
'Mother-Daughter Consecutive Yushun Himba 
(Oaks) Victory.'

The pressure weighing on her is 
immeasurable. As her Trainer, what can I 
do—
